host_run.failure_root_cause: src/app/engine/database/database.h:209 declares the database access API with untyped void* parameters. The shipped Ceedling configuration sets :cmock: :when_ptr: :compare_data, so CMock cannot learn the pointed-to size and emits UNITY_TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_PTR, a pointer-identity check. The tests pass a pointer to their own static copy while the code under test passes a different static copy, so the identity check can never succeed. Compiler- and platform-independent: a real defect in the product test setup, not a harness artefact.
host_run.platform_support: macOS is not an upstream-supported foxBMS platform; this is a host run, not target-hardware evidence
